answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The atlas is the attested output, the anchor the stranger who checks it, and the umber the tier the pair unlocks; the atlas is per identity, the anchor cannot be the farm's own, and the umber is what waiting alone cannot buy.
